description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity called DialogActivity, which demonstrates how to create an activity that appears like a pop-up dialog. It includes methods to initialize the activity, set up UI elements like buttons, and handle adding/removing images within a layout dynamically.

classes.name: DialogActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that models a dialog-like interface, allowing dynamic addition and removal of images within a linear layout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures button click handlers.

methods.name: mAddContentListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that adds an ImageView to the inner content layout.

methods.name: mRemoveContentListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that removes the last added ImageView from the inner content layout.
